name: ConicGradient
description: A rotating conic-gradient core with a wide blurred halo, a crisp counter-rotating inner ring and fine noise; the whole origin leans slightly toward the pointer with a lerped tilt.
a11yNotes: Glow, ring and noise layers are aria-hidden with pointer-events: none, so the pointer tilt never blocks interaction with children. Rotation pauses off-screen or at speed 0; prefers-reduced-motion stops rotation and disables the pointer tilt.

propsApi.name: speed
propsApi.description: Rotation speed multiplier; 1 = one turn per 14s, 0 pauses.

propsApi.name: blur
propsApi.description: Blur radius of the outer glow in px.

propsApi.name: spread
propsApi.description: Diameter of the conic core as a percentage of the component width.

propsApi.name: interactive
propsApi.description: Tilt the gradient origin slightly toward the pointer.

propsApi.name: ring
propsApi.description: Show the crisp counter-rotating inner ring.

propsApi.name: noise
propsApi.description: Overlay a fine static noise texture.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
